source.check: returned unopposed: 'All 13 retiring Unionist members ... are returned unopposed' (Northern Whig, 21 May 1958, p. 9, image read); 'Mr. Moses Busby, who was yesterday unanimously re-elected chairman of Dungannon Rural Council' at its first meeting (Belfast News-Letter, 13 June 1958, p. 9, image read)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Three contests, all in the Coalisland area: Mountjoy, Meenagh and Coalisland; 'All 13 retiring Unionist members and five Nationalists are returned unopposed' (Northern Whig, 21 May 1958, p. 9). Council-meeting method: division inferred from the 2 June 1955 return (Minterburn: Mr. M. Busby, Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1955, p. 8); the Belfast News-Letter, 13 June 1958, p. 9 names Mr. Moses Busby as re-elected chairman at the first meeting of the new council. Returned unopposed.
